what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Mexico in the United States: people who have asked for protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 209796 Mexican asylum seekers in the United States, 88.6% of all Mexican asylum seekers.
A much smaller group, 13850 people, was counted as Mexican refugees there.

why.text: The sources here don't say why people left Mexico.
The only armed conflict UCDP records for Mexico in this data is one over the government with the EPR in 1996.

when.text: The figure rose from 11902 in 2000 to 209796 in 2025, its highest.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2021 to 2025, after big changes in most years from 2009 to 2015.

how.text: These are year-end totals of people whose claims had not yet been decided, and UNHCR adds notes to some of them.
The figures have no breakdown by gender or age.
The sources don't say how people travelled or where in the United States they live.
